description:
1. Agent reads `prd.json` and discovers 4 user stories. It must sort by `priority` ascending and skip US-001 (passes=true). The array order is a trap — US-004 (priority=4) is listed first. The correct next story is US-002 (priority=2, 'Remove placeholder TODO comment from cli.ts').
2. Agent reads `progress.txt` and uses the `## Codebase Patterns` section to understand that quality checks are `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` via plain Node.js scripts.
3. Agent checks the current git branch (main) against `prd.json.branchName` ('ralph/filter-feature') and creates/checks out that branch.
4. Agent implements US-002 by removing the `// TODO:` comment from `src/cli.ts` while preserving the rest of the file.
5. Agent runs all three quality checks (`npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`) which must all pass.
6. Agent commits with the exact message `feat: US-002 - Remove placeholder TODO comment from cli.ts`.
7. Agent sets `prd.userStories[US-002].passes = true` (boolean) in prd.json, preserving all other fields and stories.
8. Agent appends (not overwrites) a new block to `progress.txt` with a date/time header for US-002, a description, files changed, learnings, and a `---` separator.
